rubric.criterion: Finds the world-readable bucket (IN1), the SSH rule open to 0.0.0.0/0 (IN4) and the unauthenticated POST method (IN8), each tied to the README requirement it breaks. Partial credit for two of three.
Finds the wildcard function role permissions (IN5), the trust policy with Principal AWS * (IN6) and the support policy with s3:* and iam:* (IN10), and explains who could abuse each.
Finds the missing bucket encryption and versioning (IN2), the missing table recovery, encryption and deletion safeguards (IN3) and the plain-text database password (IN7).
The replacement support policy gives read access to the Orders table and to objects under uploads/ only, names specific resource ARNs, and has no write, delete or identity action.
Does not claim any control exists that the template lacks (encryption, recovery, a secret store, a private bucket), invents no resource, and leaves the original files unchanged.
